scope: Krea2 (k2) branch: VNCCS pose depth as a selectable control source
problem: The k2 branch already routed a depth map into the Krea2 depth ControlNet-LoRA, but the VNCCS pose studio output (1172) only fed a preview and a before/after compare node, so the pose reference never reached the model.

change.pattern_alignment: same shape as the existing line-art source selector 1157

added_nodes.title: [05B6] Depth 来源选择（参考图 / VNCCS 姿势）

change.branch_and_group: the three nodes are appended to the k2 branch nodeIds and tagged uap_layout_group CORE-05 参考预处理与控制图生成 · K2 Krea2
change.default_behaviour: select=(none) with mode=priority resolves to input_01, so the encoded control and the rendered result stay as they were until the dropdown selects input_02

source_preservation.other_nodes_and_parameters: only the three nodes above were added and one link was rerouted; no existing widget, mode, title or prompt changed
source_preservation.branch_metadata: k2 nodeIds gained the three new ids only
source_preservation.encoding_note: links in this file use the array form [id, origin, origin_slot, target, target_slot, type]

structural.note: subgraph boundary ports (-10 / -20) are excluded by design

depth_source_ab.method: one frontend session, the pose capture pre-uploaded once so both runs use the same pose, then two submissions that differ only in the switch position
depth_source_ab.reading: the encoder output follows whichever depth source the switch selects; the two sources themselves are unchanged between runs

limits: One prompt, one seed, one base model and one sampler setting; no strength sweep or base-model comparison.
Pose fidelity of the produced image is not certified.
The probes replaced node 1191 with a LoadImage node inside the isolated runtime only; the deployed workflow was not modified by them.
No conclusion is drawn that the control plugin is defective; the effective-vs-not question is left to a strength or base-model comparison.

deployment.restart: saved original command line with AKI_HUISHI_PROFILE=production

on_off_on.reading: switching the depth control on does not change the render, and the off case reproduces

noise control image.reading: the control path can strongly affect sampling

probes.reading: arbitrary control images all change the render, so the chain is wired and injecting; the natural depth map is the case that lands in the same basin as the unconstrained model

full_sampling.interpretation: Krea2 depth control is wired and can affect sampling, but with this Turbo base model, 8 steps and LoRA strength 1 it is not distinguishable from no control when the control map is the natural depth of the reference image
